title: Bin & Recycling Collection Reminder
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bincollection:event
| eval hours_to=round((collection_epoch-now())/3600,1)
| where hours_to>0 AND hours_to<24
| sort hours_to
| table bin_type collection_epoch hours_to
description: Reminds you which bins go out tomorrow so you never miss a collection and wait another fortnight.
value: A missed bin day means overflowing rubbish for two weeks; a timely reminder is a small but real quality-of-life win.
implementation: Ingest the council collection calendar into `index=personal`; alert the evening before a collection.
visualization: Table of upcoming bin collections by type and time.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you which bins to put out the night before, so you never miss a collection again.
